notice: Synthetic historical help-desk tickets and incidents for the Ingram Trials invoice desk. Written as user reports from the user-facing screens and route list only, without reading BASE/docs or any v1 assessment finding. Not real people, customers or events. Resolution notes record help-desk actions, never code diagnoses. Seven tickets were removed (never rewritten) after an independent critic classified them as moderately or weakly resembling v1 findings; see TOOLS/mock-mcp/ticket-finding-overlap.json.

records.title: New starter needs invoice desk access
records.description: A new team member joins on Monday and needs to prepare invoices and view invoice history. Please set up the same access as the rest of the billing team.
records.resolution_note: Access granted after team lead confirmation.

records.title: Second-floor printer offline, cannot print invoice copies
records.description: The billing printer on level 2 shows offline for everyone. We need paper copies for a customer collecting today.
records.resolution_note: Facilities restarted the print server; queue cleared.

records.title: How do I remove a line before saving?
records.description: I added the wrong product to an invoice I was preparing. How do I take that line off without starting again?
records.resolution_note: Walked the user through the draft lines table.

records.title: Locked out after holiday leave
records.description: I was away for three weeks and now my login is locked. Please unlock it.
records.resolution_note: Directory account unlocked; user reset password.

records.title: New docking station range missing from product list
records.description: Sales have started selling the new docking station range but the products do not appear in the product dropdown when preparing an invoice.
records.resolution_note: Product master update requested from the catalogue team; products visible next day.

records.title: Desk felt very slow first thing after the new year
records.description: Opening invoice history took a long time this morning and the page seemed to hang for a while before the list appeared. It was fine again by lunch.
records.resolution_note: Could not reproduce later in the day. Passed to the application team for awareness; no cause recorded.

records.title: Remove access for leaver
records.description: A contractor finished on Friday. Please remove their invoice desk and shared drive access.
records.resolution_note: Access removed and confirmed to requester.

records.title: Branch office cannot reach any internal sites
records.description: Nobody at the branch office can open the invoice desk or email. Phones work.
records.resolution_note: Network team replaced a failed branch switch; service restored after two hours.

records.title: Invoice saved against the wrong customer
records.description: I picked a customer with a similar name and saved the invoice before noticing. What is the correct way to fix this?
records.resolution_note: Finance procedure followed: credit request raised against the incorrect invoice and a new invoice prepared.

records.title: Request: filter invoice history by date range
records.description: The history search works with customer names and invoice numbers, but at quarter end we want to see all invoices between two dates.
records.resolution_note: Logged for the product owner backlog.

records.title: Set up new customer account for a reseller
records.description: A new reseller signed last week. They need to appear in the customer list so billing can invoice their first order.
records.resolution_note: Customer master record created by the customer data team.

records.title: Second monitor flickering
records.description: My second screen keeps flickering, which makes it hard to compare invoice lines with the order sheet.

records.title: Good Friday month-end cover
records.description: Month-end close falls close to the Good Friday holiday. Please confirm help-desk cover hours for that weekend.

records.title: Invoice preview prints across two pages
records.description: When I print the invoice preview from the browser, the total ends up alone on a second page.
records.resolution_note: Suggested browser print scaling of 90 percent; layout request logged.

records.title: What should go in the credit reason field?
records.description: Is there a standard list of reasons for credit requests, or can I type anything?
records.resolution_note: Shared the finance team's agreed reason wording.

records.title: Invoice desk showed an error page for about twenty minutes
records.description: From about 08:40 the desk showed an error when we opened it. It came back on its own before 09:00. A few colleagues saw the same.
records.resolution_note: Service recovered without intervention. Infrastructure team noted a host restart in the same window; link to the desk not confirmed.

records.title: Read-only access for external auditors
records.description: External auditors arrive next month and want to look at invoice history and credit notes. Can they get view-only access for two weeks?
records.resolution_note: Declined direct access per policy; finance provided exported documents instead.

records.title: Refresher session for new billing staff
records.description: Three new billing staff started this quarter. Could someone run a one-hour walkthrough of preparing invoices, credit requests and the reports?
records.resolution_note: Session booked with a senior clerk as presenter.
